scoring_justification: Recompute (T1) of bulk properties from raw MD artifacts is infeasible due to the heavy simulation; SFG sign pattern is scored structurally (T3). Overall tier reflects the predominant check method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Bulk water property gold references (density, enthalpy, dipole, geometry) from paper Table III.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III (CRK model column and experimental references).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from paper's reported numerical values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published values, used as hidden comparison targets; they are not fabricated.

hidden_assets.purpose: SFG sign pattern gold and negative peak threshold from paper description and Fig. 9(c).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper description of Im[chi] sign: positive at ~3700 cm-1 and 3000-3200 cm-1, negative at 3200-3600 cm-1; negative peak depth informed by Fig. 9(c).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted qualitative sign pattern and typical peak magnitude from the paper's text and Fig. 9(c); the peak threshold (-0.005) is set leniently to accommodate run-to-run variation.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The sign pattern is the paper's main claim; the threshold is based on a typical peak depth observed in the paper's own spectrum.

outputs.description: Bulk liquid water properties computed from MD simulation. Checker compares values against paper-reported values within hidden tolerances.

Imaginary part of the ssp-polarized SFG susceptibility. Checker will verify sign pattern in three frequency bands (3000-3200 cm⁻¹ positive, 3200-3600 cm⁻¹ negative, 3650-3750 cm⁻¹ positive) and a peak in the negative band.

output_contract.notes: Only the two headline artifacts from the paper's main experiment (bulk properties and SFG spectrum) are scored. The underlying MD simulation and model implementation are required process steps but not scored directly. DFT parameter derivation, dimer assessment, and PD model comparison are omitted per taskability scope.
